messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Moin, you did your homework with the index and the other quote, I have to give you that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. 

I can come down to €31.00 per piece if we stick to 30 days payment and 28 days lead time. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. So, our Angebot is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - updated packages
messages.body:
Hallo Frau Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for matching quickly and for checking our figures. A valid competing offer is EUR 28.5 per unit (offer:70210-2); please improve your complete package.

In your e-mail of 4 September (doc:20260904-70250-M4) you asked for faster payment. One of the attached packages therefore offers 14-day payment to ease your cash flow. The others keep your standard 30-day terms. All packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months, DAP Hollerau. Your free machine capacity would be well used on the HX series from start of production.

Which of the attached packages can you sign? Is a cheaper variant possible on your side?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - updated packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. The 14 days payment helps us out, so let's go with that package. 

My guys will check the drawings to see if a cheaper variant is possible. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.06 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.79 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.49 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our offer is a price of €29.18 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
